role: Root integration verifier and arbiter; not counted among the ten fresh reviewers
interpretation: Fixed 50/50 table columns cannot accommodate enlarged nonbreaking currency amounts. This is a deliberately constrained integration stress fixture, not proof of a malformed font or a regression in the product demo. Consumer layouts need reflow/column sizing at enlarged text. At14/18px all48-subset applicable width/weight/theme cases fit.
visual_observation: 14px regular light/dark RU/EN and fallback bullets/per-mille/emoji are visible; NFC/NFD strings look equivalent. No claim of exact fallback font attribution or human reading accuracy.
recommendation: Test amounts at200% text size in real tables, then allocate sufficient numeric-column width or stack label/value rows. Never solve by shrinking accessible text or removing NBSP indiscriminately.
